ruleDefinitions.name: Alternate PowerShell Hosts - PowerShell Module
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects alternate PowerShell hosts potentially bypassing detections looking for powershell.exe Note: Unmapped fields: ContextInfo, Payload

sequences.query: ContextInfo = RGX(".**.*") AND  NOT ((ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\=\\ powershell.*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\=\\ C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\powershell.*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\=\\ C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\powershell.*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\=\\ C\\:\\/Windows\\/System32\\/WindowsPowerShell\\/v1\\\.0\\/powershell.*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\=\\ C\\:\\/Windows\\/SysWOW64\\/WindowsPowerShell\\/v1\\\.0\\/powershell.*")) OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\=\\ C\\:\\\\WINDOWS\\\\System32\\\\sdiagnhost\\\.exe\\ \\-Embedding.*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*ConfigSyncRun\\\.exe.*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\system32\\\\dsac\\\.exe.*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\system32\\\\wsmprovhost\\\.exe\\ \\-Embedding.*") OR (Payload = RGX(".*Update\\-Help.*") OR Payload = RGX(".*Failed\\ to\\ update\\ Help\\ for\\ the\\ module.*")))
